response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff-level engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript, system architecture, and technical leadership. However, he falls significantly short of the core requirement of 8+ years of experience specifically building AI-driven solutions. While his most recent role touches on relevant agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP), the complete absence of Python, Vector Databases, and RAG architectures in his profile makes him a poor fit for this specialized Staff GenAI position.
strengths: Extensive software engineering background with over 15 years of experience, including Staff-level titles and system design.
Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, which align with the key technologies required for the role.
Recent, highly relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) code generators.
concerns: Lacks the strictly required 8+ years of experience building and shipping AI-driven solutions.
No professional experience listed with Python, Vector Databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
Limited explicit experience building AI-specific data pipelines and evaluation frameworks on major cloud platforms.
